note: Light from a star left it years ago; these are dated Earth events to anchor that year. Years are astronomical (negative = BCE). Dates marked approximate are rounded in the UI with 'about'.

events.text: Earliest writing appears in Sumer
Great Pyramid of Giza completed
First recorded Olympic Games
The eclipse said to have been predicted by Thales
Earliest surviving record of Halley's Comet, in China
Ptolemy writes the Almagest
Astronomers record the supernova that made the Crab Nebula
Chinese and Japanese astronomers record supernova SN 1181
Gutenberg develops the printing press
Copernicus publishes a Sun-centred model of the planets
Tycho Brahe observes a new star (supernova SN 1572)
Galileo publishes his first telescope observations
Newton publishes the law of universal gravitation
William Herschel discovers Uranus
Neptune is found where the maths predicted
The Wright brothers make the first powered flight
Hubble shows that Andromeda is a separate galaxy
Sputnik 1, the first artificial satellite, is launched
Apollo 11 lands people on the Moon
Voyager 1 and 2 are launched
Hubble Space Telescope launched; Voyager 1 takes the Pale Blue Dot
First planet found orbiting a Sun-like star (51 Pegasi b)
First crew moves into the International Space Station
Curiosity rover lands on Mars
First direct detection of gravitational waves
James Webb Space Telescope launched
